The dimension of the symmetric subspace of 4 qubits is $\binom{4+2-1}{4} = 5$.
Since twirling preserves the trace, we have:
$$ \text{tr}(N) = \text{tr}(S \otimes S) = 4 $$
Let $N = c \Pi_{\text{sym}}^{(4)}$. Taking the trace gives:
$$ c \cdot \text{tr}(\Pi_{\text{sym}}^{(4)}) = c \cdot 5 = 4 \implies c = \frac{4}{5} $$
Thus, $N = \frac{4}{5} \Pi_{\text{sym}}^{(4)}$.

$$ \text{tr}(N^{\otimes 3} \psi^{\otimes 4}) = \frac{1}{16} \sum_{x_1, \dots, x_4} \left( \prod_{r=1}^3 \langle x_1 x_2 x_3 x_4 | N | x_1 x_2 x_3 x_4 \rangle \right) $$
